summary: Dev-1 Sprint A done: project now boots from zero on a plain Postgres and is ready for hosted Supabase. Added supabase/migrations/0000_auth_shim.sql (creates or upgrades auth.users + auth.identities when GoTrue is absent, no-op on Supabase; roles anon/authenticated/service_role; USAGE on schema auth with a permission-safe grant). 0001 now creates auth.uid()/auth.jwt() only when missing (lines 5-21 only). New scripts/db-url.ts (DATABASE_URL, maskDbUrl, default 127.0.0.1:5432/onion_crm); scripts/seed.ts applies every migrations/*.sql then seed/*.sql in filename order with per-file timing and fails on the first file by name; supabase/seed.sql git-mv'd to supabase/seed/01_core.sql and made fully idempotent (fixed ids 6666- price list, 7777- costs, 8888- contacts, ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE, legacy random-id duplicates removed, BUY counter = 4). Demo logins: on the local shim the seed writes real bcrypt hashes for DemoPass123! plus identities rows; on Supabase scripts/seed-users.ts creates the 4 users via auth.admin.createUser with the fixed UUIDs (refreshes password if already registered, fails clearly on id mismatch), and skips with the required message when keys are placeholders. package.json: db:seed = seed-users then seed, db:seed:sql = SQL only; installed eslint@8, eslint-config-next@14.2.20, server-only; .eslintrc.json makes npm run lint non-interactive. Added src/middleware.ts (Supabase updateSession with getAll/setAll + getUser), switched server.ts to getAll/setAll, admin.ts imports 'server-only'. Added docker-compose.yml (mahua-crm-postgres, PG_PORT default 5432, healthcheck, named volume), rewrote .env.example (+NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE=true, also appended to .env.local), README quickstart (local + hosted paths, 4 demo logins), docs/setup/hosted-supabase.md. Validation: fresh DB mahua_fresh seeded twice with identical counts (6/12/6/4/5/4) and all 4 hashes length 60 verifying true, then dropped; onion_crm (hand-made 7-column shim) upgraded and seeded; typecheck, lint, test (5/5), ci:tenant-check and next build all exit 0; .env.local untracked and supabase/.temp ignored.

open_issues: Web login and scripts/seed-users.ts against a real GoTrue cannot be verified yet (no Supabase stack, no hosted credentials). Only the placeholder-skip path of seed-users.ts was exercised; the createUser/updateUserById path compiles (AdminUserAttributes.id exists in installed @supabase/auth-js 2.65.1) but has not run against a live project.

Migration 0000 and the guarded 0001 block have been tested on plain Postgres (fresh and hand-made shim) only; the 'both auth tables exist' (Supabase) branch and the insufficient_privilege fallback for GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA auth are untested until credentials arrive.

tests/rls-tenant-isolation.test.ts (Dev-2's area) still applies only 0001 and 0002 itself; it passes on onion_crm only because the seed already ran 0000 there. On a brand-new database the test would need 0000 first (see notes_for_other_devs).
The 'Try as' buttons on the login page are Dev-3's work; NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE=true is already present in .env.local and .env.example.
notes_for_qa: Demo logins: admin@mahuvacrm.com (Owner), accountant@mahuvacrm.com (Accounts), sales@mahuvacrm.com (Sales), ops@mahuvacrm.com (Plant); password DemoPass123! for all four. Fixed ids 22222222-2222-4222-8222-22222222222{1,2,3,4}.

Contract deviation recorded in tasks/todo.md: the demo owner keeps all 13 modules in profiles.modules (contracts.md section 8 said to drop documents/reports/audit; the task and screens.md say keep them and hide in the menu). Accountant 10, sales 9, ops 6 modules unchanged from before.

Contract silent, choices made: price_list_items ids 66666666-6666-4666-8666-6666666666NN (01-12), product_costs 77777777-7777-4777-8777-7777777777NN (01-06), buyer_contacts 88888888-8888-4888-8888-8888888888NN (01-05) as instructed. These ranges coincide with the contract's seed-02/03 ranges for inquiries/samples/quotations in OTHER tables; different tables, so no PK clash, but do not look rows up by uuid alone.

The seed deletes legacy random-id rows for the demo org in price_list_items / product_costs / buyer_contacts that share a natural key with a fixed-id row (one-time cleanup of the old seed; on onion_crm this is why counts stayed 12/6/5 instead of doubling). Rows with other keys are left alone.
Profile full_name values are now plain names without the old role suffixes ('Hareshbhai Mehta', not 'Hareshbhai Mehta (Owner)'); the job word comes from profiles.role via labels.
auth.identities rows on the local shim use id = user id, provider 'email', provider_id = user id. Real Supabase ids differ; nothing in the app depends on identities.

Local shim detection in 01_core.sql: auth.identities exists AND role supabase_auth_admin does not exist, OR auth.users has the comment 'mahua-crm local auth shim'. On Supabase the seed never writes auth.users.

npm run db:seed = tsx scripts/seed-users.ts && tsx scripts/seed.ts; npm run db:seed:sql = SQL only. seed-users.ts prints 'Skipping auth users (no Supabase keys): local shim will insert them in SQL' when NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL/SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY are missing or contain your-project / dummy / your- placeholders.

To test a fresh bootstrap yourself: create a database with the pg client, then DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/<db> npm run db:seed (twice); counts must stay 6/12/6/4/5/4 and SELECT email, length(encrypted_password), encrypted_password = crypt('DemoPass123!', encrypted_password) FROM auth.users must show 60/true.
docker-compose.yml was written but NOT started (onion-crm-postgres holds 5432). To run both: PG_PORT=5433 docker compose up -d and point DATABASE_URL at 5433.
next build passed with the middleware (56.7 kB); public pages render. The middleware only refreshes the session (getUser); it does not redirect, pages still call requireAuth/requireModule.
notes_for_other_devs: Dev-2: scripts/db-url.ts is ready; import { DATABASE_URL, maskDbUrl } from '../scripts/db-url' (tests) or './db-url' (scripts). It loads .env.local then .env via dotenv and defaults to postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/onion_crm.

Dev-2: tests/helpers/db.ts applyMigrations should apply ALL supabase/migrations/*.sql in filename order starting with 0000_auth_shim.sql; tests/rls-tenant-isolation.test.ts currently applies only 0001 and 0002 and would fail on a fresh database (relation auth.users missing). It passes today only because the seed already ran 0000 on onion_crm.

Dev-2: migration 0003 was not present when I ran (ls supabase/migrations showed 0000, 0001, 0002). scripts/seed.ts picks it up automatically by filename order. 0001 lines 23-35 (GRANT ALL block) are untouched as agreed.

Dev-2: 0000 now creates roles anon and service_role (NOLOGIN) besides authenticated, and grants USAGE on schema auth to all three; auth.uid() as authenticated works on plain Postgres. Pre-existing: the RLS test leaves auth.users rows admin@tenant-a.com / admin@tenant-b.com / sales@tenant-a.com behind (not cleaned in afterAll).

Dev-3: NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE=true is in .env.local and documented in .env.example; gate the 'Try as' buttons on process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE === 'true'. Demo password DemoPass123!, emails as in screens.md.

Dev-3: the demo owner profile holds all 13 modules in the DB; hide documents / reports / audit from the menu (screens.md line 30). Profile full names are now plain ('Hareshbhai Mehta', 'Nileshbhai Shah', 'Pooja Patel', 'Dineshbhai Vaghela').
Dev-3: src/lib/supabase/server.ts now uses the getAll/setAll cookie API; createClient() signature is unchanged. src/lib/supabase/client.ts untouched.

All: npm run lint passed with zero warnings/errors across the whole tree at the time of my run (11:4x), so no lint findings in anyone else's files. Lint runs next/core-web-vitals; scripts/ and tests/ are not linted by next lint.
All: do not import src/lib/supabase/admin.ts from src/app/** (it now has import 'server-only' and bypasses RLS). scripts/seed-users.ts uses @supabase/supabase-js directly on purpose.
